for j in jsonToConvert:
    df = spark.read\
    .option("multiLine", "true")\
    .option("mode", "FAILFAST")\
    .json(j.path)
    
    dataEstrazione = j.path[77:85]

    #print(f"{storage_url_tmp}{dataEstrazione}/")
    lastRun = df.collect()[0][0]
    dfExploded = df.select("last_run",explode('trx_by_psp').alias('psp'))\
                    .select(\
                        col("last_run")\
                        ,col("psp.codice_articolo")\
                        ,col("psp.abi")\
                        ,col("psp.category")\
                        ,col("psp.current_trx")\
                        ,col("psp.daily_epoch")\
                        ,col("psp.name")\
                        ,col("psp.recipient_id")\
                        ,col("psp.value")\
                        ,col("psp.year_quarter")\
                        ,col("psp.daily")\
                    )
    dfExploded.repartition(1).write.options(header = True, delimiter = ',').mode('overwrite').csv(f"{storage_url_tmp}{dataEstrazione}/")
